tools.name: search_resorts
tools.description: Search resorts by name, slug, region, or US/CA state code. Returns compact snow metrics and a citation URL to the public site.

tools.name: get_resort_snow
tools.description: Snowfall and season comparison for one resort by slug (24h/7d/10d modeled, season total, % normal, vs last year). Uses precomputed Convex snapshots.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List tracked ski regions with slug and display name.

tools.name: get_region_snow
tools.description: Regional snowfall overview and season comparison for a region slug (same market dashboard as the public site).

tools.name: get_top_snowfall
tools.description: Rank resorts by 24h, 7d observed, or season-to-date inches from the resort board snapshot.

tools.name: get_weekly_summary
tools.description: Latest weekly report snapshot, bulletin headline, and highlight stats (leaders, regions above/below normal).

tools.name: get_state_snow
tools.description: Every tracked resort in a US state or Canadian province (two-letter code) with last-24h, last-7-day, next-7-day forecast and season totals, plus the canonical state page URL to cite.

tools.name: get_snow_image
tools.description: A branded PNG snow card you can look at or show the user: one resort's last 5 days + next 10 days with the best day to go (view=card), the resort's next 7 days as a calendar (view=week), or a leaderboard for a region, state or all resorts. Returns the image plus its stable public URL (cacheable, emb

tools.name: get_resort_snow_history
tools.description: Average annual snowfall, season totals by year, monthly averages and the snowiest season for a resort slug (modeled Open-Meteo archive, completed seasons only). Cite the history page URL.

tools.name: search
tools.description: OpenAI-compatible search over resorts and regions. Returns id, title, url, and text snippets with citations.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a full document by id from search results (resort:slug, history:slug, state:xx, region:id, page:this-week, site:home).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
